method: Blind re-verification of the Unit 1 blind-read fix round. All 22 items solved blind from verification/blind-read-u1-fix/ only (solves in blind-read-u1-fix-solves.json, recorded before any question file was opened), then adjudicated against the question files. Lesson spots checked by reading the lessons and by programmatic word counts.

verdicts.fix_checked: Rationale D now reads 'The engraving shows Timucua farming as Le Moyne saw it in the 1560s, before the missions reached the region, so missions cannot explain the farming.' Correct: Le Moyne was in Florida in the 1560s; the Timucua missions came later.
Skill tag is 6.D, matching the bank's other evaluation-of-a-claim items (0019, 0073, 0122).

Rationale B now reads 'No sea route through the Americas had been found by 1507. Sailors kept searching, and Magellan did not find a strait until 1520.' Correct; the false 'none would be found in this period' is gone.

Rationales A and D now say 'landed' (Columbus landed in the Caribbean in October 1492). Note, not a defect: option A's misconception still says 'sailed the same year', which is true — Columbus did sail in 1492; the defect was only 'sailed in October'.

Key B, rationale B, and general step 1 now say silver financed Spain and rival crowns spent their own money in response. The loose 'competing European crowns' phrasing and the garbled 'treasuries of Spain and its rivals\' enemies' are both gone.
Option C and rationale C now say 'lasting grant' / 'lasting claim'; general step 2 already said 'lasting grant'. No 'permanent' remains anywhere in the file.

Re-authored item tests the dating limitation (casta paintings are 18th-century evidence), skill 2.C, difficulty 4, status draft. Key explanation 82 words (bound 60-120). Option lengths A/B/C/D 11/16/14/15 words, key not longest. Does NOT duplicate 0103: 0103 asks what the comprehensive set indicates about colonial culture (systematic classification, key A); 0104 asks what limits the canvas as evidence for 1500-1607 (its 18th-century date, key D). Different propositions, different skills. Topic 1.5 distribution on disk is A6/B8/C6/D4. Ready to flip to final.

Rationale C and misconception C now say smallpox reached Tenochtitlan in late 1520, before the siege. General step 2 ('before and during the fighting') is accurate as written — the epidemic continued during the siege.

Stem, rationale A, general step 1, and misconception B all now say smallpox reached Tenochtitlan in late 1520, before the siege; city fell in 1521. Consistent with the lesson and with the corrected L5 text.

No 'two or three percent' anywhere in the file (general step 2 now says 'A tiny class of landowners owned nearly all of it'). Rationale D and misconception D no longer attribute the arms race to the passage; rationale D now rebuts the withdrawal claim on the passage's own terms.
Stimulus now ends 'Portugal's ships were already rounding Africa toward India.' Key D is derivable from the stimulus alone, and from the L2 lesson (Dias 1488, da Gama 1498). Fairness defect resolved.
All three parts exactly 2 sentences. Second sentences are genuine extensions, not restatements (variety by region/food/politics; caravel and compass; conquest breaking political structures).
All three parts exactly 2 sentences. Second sentences add genuine development (welcoming and profitable; failure would end backing; the reader learns nothing of the islanders' view).
All three parts exactly 2 sentences. Second sentences add genuine development (world still centered on Europe and Africa; Pacific and interior still blank; the line as a legal boundary).

All three parts exactly 2 sentences. Part (b) second sentence now reads 'That surplus is what let a farming town grow into a city with mounds, plazas, and thousands of residents.' It extends the first sentence (city scale) instead of repeating it (chiefs/priests/mounds).

Stimulus now ends 'Las Casas wrote his account to persuade the Spanish crown to stop the cruelty and reform the encomienda.' Part (b) is now answerable from the stimulus; my blind (b) matches the model answer. No longer duplicates SAQ 0018 without support.
